name: Turlach Post 110 EGEO
description: Key Features Halophile-Culture Dye Vat: Utilizes advanced halophile-culture technology for consistent and high-quality dyeing results, ideal for specialty textile applications. description_html:
Key Features

  • Halophile-Culture Dye Vat: Utilizes advanced halophile-culture technology for consistent and high-quality dyeing results, ideal for specialty textile applications.
  • Working Width: Supports fabrics up to 31 centimeters wide, making it suitable for small to medium-scale textile production and sample runs.
  • Precise Temperature Control: Operates at a process temperature of 16°C, ensuring optimal dye absorption and colorfastness for delicate materials.
  • Batch Throughput: Handles up to 9.1 kilograms per cycle, enabling efficient batch processing and reduced downtime.
  • Cycle Duration: Each dyeing cycle runs for 95 hours, supporting thorough and even color distribution throughout the fabric.
  • Treadle Drive Type: Manual treadle operation offers energy efficiency and precise control, suitable for environments with limited access to electrical power.
  • Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored quotations based on project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Reliable Dyeing Performance: The halophile-culture system ensures uniform coloration and minimizes dye wastage, addressing the need for consistent results in textile manufacturing.
  • Energy-Efficient Operation: Manual treadle drive reduces energy consumption and operating costs, appealing to eco-conscious users and those in off-grid settings.
  • Versatile Fabric Compatibility: The 31 cm working width and gentle temperature setting make this dye vat compatible with a variety of fabric types, including delicate and specialty textiles.
  • Scalable Production: 9.1 kg batch capacity is ideal for small production runs, prototyping, or artisan textile work, meeting the needs of boutique manufacturers and researchers.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Artisan and Boutique Textile Production: Perfect for small-scale fabric dyeing, custom textile design, and experimental dye processes.
  • Research and Development: Suitable for laboratories and research facilities exploring innovative dyeing techniques or testing new fabric treatments.
  • Eco-Friendly Manufacturing: Manual, energy-saving operation supports sustainable production practices and reduces the carbon footprint.
  • Specialty Fabric Dyeing: Designed for precise, low-temperature dyeing of sensitive or high-value materials, ensuring superior color quality and fabric integrity.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the dye vat easy to operate? Yes, the treadle drive offers intuitive manual control, making it user-friendly and accessible for operators of various skill levels.
  • What types of fabrics can be dyed? The vat accommodates a wide range of fabrics up to 31 cm wide, including delicate, specialty, and experimental textiles.
  • How is pricing determined? Pricing is customized based on your specific requirements and is set after acceptance of your order.
  • What are the advantages of halophile-culture dyeing? This method provides enhanced color consistency and efficiency, particularly for specialty textile applications requiring precise results.
